portal.system.wifi_setup.hint: When enabled (default), FlightScnr opens the setup hotspot if the network stays down past a short grace period. Turn this off on mesh or always-on Wi-Fi so NetworkManager can keep reconnecting. First-time setup with no saved Wi-Fi still uses the QR hotspot. Use Start Wi-Fi setup for recovery.
portal.system.wifi_setup.automatic.label: Automatic Wi-Fi setup hotspot
portal.system.wifi_setup.enabled: Automatic Wi-Fi setup hotspot is on.
portal.system.wifi_setup.disabled: Automatic Wi-Fi setup hotspot is off — NetworkManager will keep trying to reconnect.

portal.radar.center.label: Radar center (lat, lon)
portal.radar.range.label: Range
portal.radar.range.hint: Outer radar range shown as mi / km / nm.
portal.radar.units.label: Units (distance, speed)
portal.radar.units.hint: Distance for range rings / labels, and speed for aircraft/vessel readouts on the Pi display.
portal.radar.altitude_min.label: Min altitude floor (ft, 0 = off)
portal.radar.altitude_max.label: Max altitude ceiling (ft)
portal.radar.altitude.hint: Show only aircraft between the floor and ceiling. Max is raised automatically if it would sit below min.
portal.radar.smart_autofloor.label: Smart AutoFloor (requires Auto Idle Clock)
portal.radar.smart_autofloor.hint: Inactive while Auto Idle Clock is off. When active, temporarily lowers the radar floor by 500 ft after 5 seconds with no visible aircraft traffic, down to 0 ft. AIS vessels do not affect AutoFloor. The Min altitude floor above remains the saved Standard and is restored as aircraft traffic climbs back up.
portal.radar.theme.label: Radar Theme
portal.radar.theme.hint: Accent color for the sweep, range rings, and labels.
portal.radar.runway_color.label: Runway Centerline Color for Dark Map
portal.radar.runway_color.hint: Sets RUNWAY_DARKMAP — runway centerline color on the dark basemap (skipped on VFR).
portal.radar.map_style.label: Map style
portal.radar.map_style.hint: Dark/Light/Voyager Carto need a free CARTO_BASEMAPS_API_KEY. Dark: Stadia and Light: Toner need a free STADIA_MAPS_API_KEY. OSM, Esri, Flat, and VFR need no key. VFR sectionals are public-domain FAA charts (US coverage). Nautical: Seamap is an Open Waters chart with depths and seamarks (no key). Not for navigation.
portal.radar.vfr_opacity.label: VFR map opacity
portal.radar.vfr_opacity.hint: How strong the VFR chart appears under traffic (lower = paler). Applies when map style is VFR.
portal.radar.seamap_opacity.label: Seamap opacity
portal.radar.seamap_opacity.hint: How strong the nautical chart appears under traffic (lower = paler, like the VFR chart). Applies when the map style is Nautical: Seamap. Not for navigation.
portal.radar.compass.label: Show compass rose
portal.radar.range_rings.label: Show range rings
portal.radar.altitude_colors.label: Color aircraft by altitude
portal.radar.traffic_labels.label: Traffic labels
portal.radar.traffic_labels.hint: Callsign/type/altitude on aircraft, and vessel name tags. Turn off to declutter a busy radar; tap a symbol for details.
portal.radar.aircraft_id.label: Aircraft ID on tags
portal.radar.aircraft_id.hint: Top line of each aircraft tag: marketing flight number (e.g. UA5796), ATC callsign (e.g. SKW5796), tail / registration (e.g. N12345), or alternate through whichever of those differ.
portal.radar.tag_leaders.label: Show tag leaders
portal.radar.tag_leaders.hint: Hockey-stick underline and diagonal from each callsign tag to its aircraft or vessel. Same color as the blip. Only drawn when traffic labels are on.
portal.radar.rim_targets.label: Out-of-range rim targets
portal.radar.rim_targets.hint: Aircraft past the radar range are pinned to the rim. Dot draws a small half-round blip flat against the edge; aircraft icon keeps the compact plane symbol.
portal.radar.facing.label: Facing direction (degrees)
portal.radar.facing.hint: Real-world direction at the top of the screen (0 = north, 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west). You can also set this on the device under Settings → Display → Facing.
portal.radar.sweep.label: Show radar sweep line
portal.radar.precipitation.label: Show precipitation
portal.radar.precipitation.hint_before_l: Live rain/snow radar overlay: tries open-source
portal.radar.precipitation.hint_after_ra: as fallback. Checks for a new frame every minute; keeps the cached map until new data arrives (capped at ~30 req/min).
portal.radar.wildfires.label: Show wildfires
portal.radar.wildfires.hint_large_fires: large fires (no API key). Outside USA/Canada:
portal.radar.wildfires.hint_finish: in API Keys). Tap a fire for details. Refreshes every 15 minutes and on recenter.
portal.radar.earthquakes.label: Show earthquakes
portal.radar.earthquakes.hint_after_sour: catalog (no API key), last 24 hours — same default window as the USGS live map. PAGER impact alerts and tsunami bulletins show on the detail page. Tap a marker for magnitude, depth, and place. Refreshes every minute and on recenter. Voice alerts are under Display, screens & volume (device: Settings → HUD & Volume).
portal.radar.airport_centerlines.label: Show airport centerlines
portal.radar.airport_centerlines.hint: OurAirports runway centerlines for large, medium, and small airports in range (dark and light maps; skipped on VFR — the chart already shows runways). Heliports and closed fields/runways are skipped.
portal.radar.airport_icons.label: Show airport icons
portal.radar.airport_icon_style.label: Airport icon style
portal.radar.airport_icon_style.hint: Chart style draws VFR-sectional symbols: blue = towered, magenta = untowered, tines = fuel available, star = rotating beacon. Fuel/beacon marks use FAA data and are US airports only.
portal.radar.airport_min_size.label: Smallest airports shown
portal.radar.airport_min_size.hint: OurAirports tags most dirt strips and private fields as small airports. "Paved only" keeps small fields with at least one paved runway.
portal.radar.airport_icons.hint: Airport pin icons (airport.png) for large, medium, and small airports in range. Heliports and closed fields are skipped.
portal.radar.flip_board.label: Arrival / departure board
portal.radar.flip_board.hint: Split-flap arrivals and departures for each airport in radar range, by tail number, flight number, or callsign. Movements are worked out on the device from the aircraft the radar already tracks, so no flight-schedule subscription is needed. Swipe left from the radar to reach it; tap the board to flip between arrivals and departures, or tap a row for an aircraft tile. The ID button next to Next picks which identity the flaps show.
portal.radar.flip_board_id.label: Board identity
portal.radar.flip_board_id.hint: What each split-flap row shows. Missing values fall back (a GA tail with no flight number still shows the N-number).
portal.radar.flip_board_sound.label: Board flip sound
portal.radar.flip_board_sound.hint: Split-flap clatter while the arrivals board turns. Density follows how many tiles are moving. Needs a speaker, and follows the master sound switch and the off-hours schedule.
portal.radar.ground_vehicles.label: Show ground vehicles
portal.radar.ground_vehicles.hint: Airport ground vehicles (tugs, service vans, ARFF, etc.) when ADS-B reports type codes like GRND/GVEH/SERV. Turn off to declutter the radar near airports.
portal.radar.traffic_mode.label: Radar traffic
portal.radar.traffic_mode.hint: Marine uses aisstream.io when a key is set, and falls back to Open Waters AIS if that stream is missing or down. No key is required for the fallback. aisstream.io is free for non-commercial use.
portal.radar.vessel_min_speed.label: Marine min speed
portal.radar.vessel_min_speed.hint: Hide AIS vessels at or below this speed over ground. Use to declutter anchored/moored traffic while keeping movers. Options follow the Distance units setting above.
portal.radar.aircraft_min_speed.label: Aircraft min speed
portal.radar.aircraft_min_speed.hint: Hide aircraft at or below this ground speed. Use to declutter taxiing/parked traffic while keeping airborne movers. Options follow the Distance units setting above.
portal.favorites.icao.label: ICAO Code (optional)
portal.favorites.name.label: Location Name
portal.favorites.position.label: Location Position (lat, lon)
portal.favorites.add.hint: Radar center above is Home. After Set Radar Center on the Pi you can Update the active favorite, Save as Home, or keep as Custom. The last center is what reboot restores. Pick a saved center under Settings → Options → Favorite Locations. Max 10 favorites.
portal.local_adsb.enabled.label: Use local dump1090 / readsb
portal.local_adsb.url.label: aircraft.json URL
portal.local_adsb.hint_before_marker: Local receiver feed (dump1090-fa, readsb, or tar1090). Merges with FR24/adsb.fi; local positions win on overlap. Leave off if nothing is listening — connection refused will spam the logs. Aircraft heard locally show a
portal.local_adsb.hint_after_marker: before the callsign on the radar tag.
portal.route_sources.order.label: Route lookup order
portal.route_sources.order.hint_before_e: Comma-separated: airlabs, flightaware, opensky — tried in this order, first match per field wins, gaps filled by the next. Omit an entry to disable it entirely. Example for a fully free/open-source lookup with no paid API ever called:
portal.route_sources.order.hint_after_ex: . Leave blank for the default order (airlabs,flightaware,opensky).
portal.position_sources.marine.title: Marine traffic
portal.position_sources.marine.hint: Stream order for vessel traffic. The first source that can connect is used; the other is the fallback if that stream fails. aisstream.io needs an API key. Open Waters works without one. Drag to reorder.
portal.position_sources.hint_before_path: Fallback order for the live-centered map (
portal.position_sources.hint_after_path: ). First source that has a fresh position for the tracked aircraft wins. Drag to reorder; a source with no key/URL configured is skipped automatically even if left in the list.
portal.position_sources.heading_up.label: Rotate map to heading (default: north-up)
How far ahead (at current ground speed) the Follow map tries to show. Larger = wider zoom at the same speed. Default 5.
portal.position_sources.min_radius.label: Follow min radius
portal.position_sources.min_radius.hint: Floor for the speed-based zoom curve (not the taxi snap). Default matches ~2 mi.
portal.position_sources.max_radius.label: Follow max radius
portal.position_sources.max_radius.hint: Ceiling for cruise / high-speed Follow zoom.
portal.alerts.military.label: Alert on military aircraft
portal.alerts.emergency.label: Alert on emergency squawk (7700/7600/7500)
portal.alerts.hide_other.label: Hide non-alerted aircraft on radar
portal.alerts.watch_flights.label: Watch list (flight numbers / registrations)
portal.alerts.watch_flights.hint_after_e: when they enter range — not a worldwide follow (use Tracking for that). Enter ICAO flight numbers (UAL1083) and/or registrations / tail numbers (N2136U, D-AIML), comma-separated. Clear and Save to remove.
portal.alerts.watch_types.label: Watch list (aircraft types)
portal.alerts.watch_types.hint: Alert on every aircraft of a given type on local radar. Use ICAO type codes (B738, A337) or designations (A330-743), comma-separated. Clear and Save to remove.
portal.tracking.flight.label: Track flight number or registration
portal.tracking.hint_after_emphasis: aircraft worldwide on the Tracked screen (route, ETA, pin) — even outside radar range. Enter an ICAO flight number (UAL1083) or a registration / tail number (N2136U, CS-TPQ). For many flights or types on local radar only, use Alerts instead.
portal.tracking.route_search.label: Route search (live)
portal.display.brightness.label: Screen brightness
portal.display.quiet_dim.label: Dim during quiet hours
portal.display.quiet_dim_level.label: Quiet-hours dim level
portal.display.quiet_dim_level.hint: Caps the screen at this brightness while ATC quiet hours are active. Same as Settings → Quiet on the device, where the slider previews the dimness live.
portal.display.rotation.label: Screen rotation
portal.display.rotation.hint: Rotate the entire UI and touch mapping for how the Pi/panel is mounted. Same as Settings → Display → Rotate on the device.
portal.display.detail_timeout.label: Flight detail screen timeout
portal.display.clock_timeout.label: Clock / forecast timeout
portal.display.idle_clock.label: Return to clock when no aircraft visible
portal.display.clock_12hr.label: 12-hour clock (AM/PM)
portal.display.clock_12hr.hint: Applies everywhere: radar HUD, clock screen, and settings. Off = 24-hour.
portal.display.flight_trails.label: Flight trails on radar
portal.display.flight_trails.hint: Path flown so far, coloured by ground speed (blue = slow, red = fast). Only the path seen since the aircraft entered range is shown.
portal.display.european_date.label: European date format
portal.display.day_clock.label: Daytime clock face
portal.display.off_hours_clock.label: Off-hours clock face
portal.display.clock_faces.hint: Daytime face is used outside the Off-Hours window; off-hours face while that schedule is active (force-clock, auto-idle, or opening the clock). Swipe between faces still works.
portal.display.radar_hud.label: Show radar clock HUD
portal.display.hud_dark.label: HUD dark mode
portal.display.texture.label: Background texture
portal.display.hud_position.label: Radar HUD position
portal.display.hud_opacity.label: Radar clock opacity
portal.display.hud_opacity.hint: Frosted glass pill behind the radar clock and icons (0% = invisible fill, 100% = solid). Dark mode uses a dark pill with light glyphs.
portal.display.zoom_buttons.label: Radar zoom −/+ buttons
portal.display.zoom_buttons.hint: Faint −/+ pill on the edge of the radar. Taps step the range like pinch zoom.
portal.display.zoom_position.label: Zoom buttons position
portal.display.chime.label: Hourly chime
portal.display.chime_volume.label: Hourly chime volume
portal.display.tracked_sound.label: Tracked enter-range sound
portal.display.tracked_volume.label: Tracked enter volume
portal.display.tracked_sound.hint: Plays when a live tracked flight crosses into radar range.
portal.display.military_sound.label: Military aircraft sound
portal.display.military_volume.label: Military sound volume
portal.display.military_sound.hint: Plays once when a new military aircraft appears in radar range.
portal.display.iss_sound.label: ISS sound
portal.display.iss_volume.label: ISS sound volume
portal.display.iss_sound.hint: Plays once when the ISS enters the radar.
portal.display.earthquake_sound.label: Earthquake alert
portal.display.earthquake_volume.label: Earthquake alert volume
portal.display.earthquake_sound.hint: Off by default. Plays a voice clip once per new USGS event M3.0+ in radar range. Not earthquake early warning — catalog events can be minutes old. Silent during quiet hours and display off-hours. Needs the earthquake layer on, plus a USB or Bluetooth speaker.
portal.lofi.enabled.label: Background lofi beats
portal.lofi.enabled.hint: Mellow music under the live ATC stream, crossfading through the playlist. Plays only while ATC audio is on, so it follows ATC quiet hours.
portal.lofi.volume.label: Lofi volume
portal.lofi.controls.label: Lofi prev/next buttons
portal.lofi.controls.hint: Prev/next pill on the rim opposite the clock HUD. Shows only while the beats are enabled.
portal.lofi.scroll.label: Scroll lofi track name
portal.lofi.scroll.hint: Marquee the lofi track name through the pill. Off = truncate long names at 20 characters.
portal.lofi.pack.not_installed: The starter playlist is not installed yet — the beats need tracks to play.
portal.lofi.tracks.hint: Tap a track to preview it here. Switch a built-in off to drop it from the rotation on the display. Your uploads can be removed with ✕.
portal.off_hours.enabled.label: Enable off-hours (night mode)
portal.off_hours.clock.label: Show clock during off-hours
portal.off_hours.hint: Dim/off and clock can be combined — e.g. turn the display off (or dim it) and still force the clock screen. Quiet-hours dim under Display is a separate schedule tied to ATC quiet hours.
portal.targets.hint: Per-category visibility for the radar: accent color, size, and symbol for planes, helicopters, drones, and vessels, plus compass rose and blip styling. Same as Settings → Targets on the device. Auto keeps today's default look.
portal.weather.units.label: Units
portal.weather.fetch.hint: Clears the local rate-limit backoff and asks the display to call Tomorrow.io once. Current weather/wind also refresh automatically at :01 and :31; forecast with the :01 slot. Use sparingly (free tier ≈ 25 requests/hour).
portal.atc.hint_before_mpv: Manual LiveATC stream to the Pi’s USB or Bluetooth speaker via
portal.atc.hint_after_install: ). Pair a Bluetooth speaker in the card below. Airport lists every large/medium field in radar range. Channel loads local seed/index immediately, then auto-fetches the full LiveATC feed list in the background (Cloudflare-bypass search). Enable ATC audio to start playback; disable to stop. Changing airport or moving the map while ATC is enabled selects that area’s Tower and keeps playing. Playback resumes after reboot/app restart when it was left enabled. Quiet hours block auto-resume after reboot; turning ATC on again overrides quiet hours until you disable it.
portal.atc.enabled.label: Enable ATC audio
portal.atc.quiet_hours.label: Quiet hours
portal.atc.airport.label: Airport
portal.atc.channel.label: Channel
portal.bluetooth.hint_before_bluez: Scan, pair, and select a Bluetooth speaker for ATC audio and the hourly chime. On the round display, Settings → ATC shows status and a quick Use Bluetooth reconnect for the speaker paired here. Put the speaker in pairing mode before Scan / Pair & Connect. Requires
portal.bluetooth.devices.label: Nearby / paired devices
portal.api_keys.flightaware.hint: Route enrichment only when FR24/AirLabs lack origin/destination — not a live radar feed. Soft monthly spend ceiling protects free credit.
portal.api_keys.opensky.hint_before_link: Route enrichment fallback when FR24/AirLabs/FlightAware lack origin/destination, and optional live-position source for extended tracking. Create an API client under Account → API Client on
portal.api_keys.opensky.hint_after_link: (separate from feeder credentials). Destination is often empty while airborne.
portal.api_keys.adsbexchange.hint_before: Optional live-position fallback for extended tracking (after OpenSky in the default order). RapidAPI plan/quota varies — leave empty to skip. See
portal.api_keys.openwaters.hint_before_l: Optional. Anonymous Open Waters AIS works without a key (smaller area). A key from
portal.api_keys.firms.hint_after_link: . Used for satellite hotspots when the radar is outside the USA and Canada. In California: CAL FIRE; elsewhere in USA/Canada: NIFC WFIGS (no key).
portal.api_keys.carto.hint_after_link: (no CARTO account required). Required for Dark: Carto, Light: Carto, and Street: Voyager — without it tiles show an “API key required” watermark.
portal.api_keys.stadia.hint_after_link: . Required for Dark: Stadia and Light: Toner basemap styles on the Radar card.
portal.updates.resync.hint: After Update Now, the device may briefly re-sync install steps automatically (X11 / display). If LightDM is switched to X11 for pinch-zoom, the Pi reboots on its own.
portal.updates.auto.label: Auto-install during off-hours
portal.updates.auto_time.label: Auto-update time (optional)
portal.updates.hide_banner.label: Hide update banner on device
portal.updates.auto.hint: When on, an available update installs in the night window (Off Hours start/end, or 22:00–06:00) after the panel has been idle for 5 minutes. Dismissing the radar bubble skips that version. ATC playing also delays the install.
portal.updates.auto.behavior_hint: When Auto-install is on, the update banner stays hidden on the radar/clock screen entirely; it installs silently. By default it installs in the Off Hours window (start/end above, or 22:00–06:00) once the panel has been idle for 5 minutes. Set a specific Auto-update time instead if you want updates to run at a fixed time independent of your Off Hours schedule (a window of about an hour after that time). Dismissing the radar bubble skips that version. ATC playing also delays the install. Hide update banner works on its own too: turn it on to stop the on-screen banner without enabling auto-install, so updates only happen when you tap Update Now here in the portal.
portal.updates.repair.hint_before_action: If you are stuck on an old version and
portal.updates.repair.hint_between: is missing, on the Pi open
portal.system.backup.hint_before_path: Download a backup of portal preferences (radar, display, alerts, weather, off-hours, favourites, location, ATC, and API keys). The file includes secrets — keep it private. Does not include maps, photos, or
portal.system.diagnostics.hint: Download a diagnostics package for support (Pi model, OS, disk, recent logs). API keys are redacted. Attach the zip on Discord or a GitHub issue.
portal.system.restore.hint_after_extensi: file. This overwrites matching preference files on the Pi and relaunches the app.
portal.system.disclaimer.hint_before_emp: Safety disclaimer: always shown at boot. On the touchscreen you can check
portal.system.disclaimer.hint_after_emph: then tap Accept to enable an eight-second countdown on later boots (no Accept during the countdown — the checkbox state is saved when the timer ends). The portal can only clear that saved choice — it cannot enable or restore it.
portal.system.power.hint: Relaunch the app, or restart / power off this Raspberry Pi. Reboot and shutdown take the display and portal offline.
portal.master_caution.hint_after_system: first if you want to keep radar prefs and API keys. Wi-Fi and dump1090 are not touched. If this button fails with a sudo error, tap
portal.master_caution.clean_install.hint: Deletes the FlightScnr checkout, all settings, API keys, watch lists, and maps, then reinstalls from GitHub and reboots. Once you start, there is no going back.
portal.footer.wifi: First-time Wi-Fi uses the on-device QR setup hotspot when no network is configured. Automatic hotspot after a lost link can be changed under System.
portal.position_sources.min_radius.dynam: Floor for the speed-based zoom curve (not the taxi snap under {taxi_speed}, which stays ~{taxi_distance} {unit}). Default {default_min} {unit}.
portal.position_sources.max_radius.dynam: Ceiling for cruise / high-speed Follow zoom. Default {default_max} {unit}.

portal.weather.providers_hint: Tomorrow.io is preferred when enabled and configured. Open-Meteo automatically supplies weather if Tomorrow.io is unavailable, including when its switch is off. No Open-Meteo API key is needed.
portal.weather.fetch.providers_hint: Requests a current-weather refresh from the display, with automatic Open-Meteo fallback. Clears the local Tomorrow.io backoff; server quotas still apply. Current weather and wind refresh at :01 and :31; forecasts at :01. Use manual refresh sparingly.
portal.display.flight_trail_seconds.hint: How long a trail stays visible; it fades out from the back and keeps fading after the aircraft has left the display.
portal.radar.hud_tap_labels.label: Tap the HUD to switch tags (always on / only when tapped)
portal.radar.hud_tap_labels.hint: A tap on the free area of the radar HUD pill flips the traffic labels between your normal mode and "Only when tapped". Off keeps the HUD taps as before.
portal.radar.smooth_motion.label: Smooth aircraft motion
portal.radar.smooth_motion.hint: Glide icons between radar updates instead of stepping them. Off keeps the usual baked icons. Fly smoothly in/out needs this on.
